meta.name: Railway main lines of India (Natural Earth 10m railroads, simplified)
meta.limitations: Natural Earth shows the main trunk network only at 1:10m scale, with no line names and no branch lines. The electrification flag is as given by Natural Earth and may be out of date. Lines are simplified (0.01 degrees) and merged, so a row is a chain of segments, not an official route. OSM via Overpass was tried and failed (overload).
meta.method: Select Natural Earth railroads that touch India (polygon of India from Natural Earth admin-0, 0.05 degree buffer), clip to that polygon, merge touching segments (shapely linemerge) by electrified / not, simplify with tolerance 0.01 degrees, drop chains shorter than 3 km, round coordinates to 3 decimals. State is the state at the line mid-point (lines cross many states). No station list: no reliable open list with coordinates was found.
